svg.title: Live model catalogue — how a newly released Claude model reaches the AI-Engines pickers
svg.text: Live model catalogue — the AI-Engines model pickers keep themselves current
Curated YAML list = the floor (works with no API key). Live catalogue only ADDS ids. Fetching happens in the console, never on the engine spawn path.
GET /settings/engine/registry
console route · session-authenticated · returns immediately
_maybe_refresh_model_catalog()
stale (>12 h) ∧ not in-flight ∧ ≥30 min since last try ∧ L35 allows
background thread
never blocks the page load
engine_providers.fetch_models("anthropic")
GET api.anthropic.com/v1/models · x-api-key + anthropic-version
follows has_more / last_id · key via provider_keys (env → service.env)
on success only
model_catalog.store_models()
~/.corvin/global/model_catalog.json · 0600 · atomic replace
rejects an EMPTY list — last-good is never wiped
no API key / HTTP error / unreachable
nothing written · picker keeps the curated list · retry floor 30 min
engine_models.load_registry()
every reader — console, personas, engine SPAWN path
reads the cache FILE only · re-merges when its mtime changes
cached ids — no network on this side
_merge_live_models() — curated first, live appended
curated order and `default: true` preserved · already-curated ids not duplicated
per-engine prefix: claude_code "" · opencode "anthropic/" (its "<provider>/<model>" form)
a role with an EMPTY curated list stays empty (codex_cli — no model choice exists)
no catalogue / corrupt cache → no-op, i.e. exactly the pre-existing curated list
Console → AI Engines → Per-Engine Model Configuration
dropdown shows curated + newly released models · "Refresh models" forces a fetch now
